title: Reviving our data foundations is the most disruptive step to data maturity
abstract: arXiv:2608.29368v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The most disruptive step that enterprises of small-medium size and maturity can take to make the most of the latest technological advances in AI is to step back from the hype and focus on establishing or reviving a good knowledge foundation layer. It is a hard message to present to the executive team; therefore, it needs to be backed by evidence, and its implementation needs to be of minimal impact on the existing processes. In this vision statement, we discuss how we need to rethink what evidence speaks to the decision-makers and propose a low-impact data strategy that adapts to the existing and ever-changing data flows and processes across the company. We firmly believe that knowledge graph techniques will increasingly become non-negotiable in the data strategy of an AI-powered enterprise, provided that we approach their design in a modular, dynamic and cross-functional way.

translated_title: 振兴数据基础是迈向数据成熟度的最具颠覆性的一步
translated_abstract: 对于中小型规模和成熟度的企业而言，要充分利用AI领域的最新技术进步，最具颠覆性的一步是避开炒作，专注于建立或振兴良好的知识基础层。这是一个难以向高管团队传达的信息，因此需要有证据支持，且其实施需要对现有流程的影响最小化。在这份愿景陈述中，我们讨论了如何重新思考什么样的证据能够说服决策者，并提出了一种低影响的数据策略，该策略能够适应公司现有且不断变化的数据流和流程。我们坚信，只要以模块化、动态和跨职能的方式进行设计，知识图谱技术将日益成为AI驱动企业数据战略中不可或缺的部分。
tldr: 中小企业要充分受益于AI技术进步，最具颠覆性的关键一步是振兴数据基础层，通过模块化、动态、跨职能的知识图谱技术构建低影响的数据战略。
en_tdlr: For small-medium enterprises to fully benefit from AI advances, the most disruptive step is reviving their data foundations through modular, dynamic, and cross-functional knowledge graph techniques within a low-impact data strategy.
